description: This Java source file defines the 'ShoppingCartHelper' class, which provides utility methods for manipulating shopping cart objects within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for adding, modifying, deleting, and retrieving cart items, as well as handling order agreements and constants related to shopping cart operations.

classes.name: ShoppingCartHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manipulate shopping cart instances, including adding, modifying, and removing items, handling order agreements, and managing cart-related operations in the OFBiz e-commerce system.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, supporting various parameters such as product details, pricing, quantity, reservation dates, configuration, and context. Validates input parameters and handles special conditions like comments and delivery dates.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items to the shopping cart based on order ID, either all items or specified subset, transferring order details to the cart while handling errors.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple products in bulk according to quantities specified in the request context, supporting special prefixes for grouping and alternative packing considerations.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds multiple requirement-based items to the cart from a category, handling row-based form submissions, facility settings, and error reporting.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds all products from a specified category to the cart, using default quantities and handling entity fetch errors.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes specified items from the cart based on context parameters, supporting batch deletion.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Modifies the cart items, including updating quantities, descriptions, comments, prices, and handling item deletions based on user input; also runs promotion calculations post-update.

methods.name: getCartObject
methods.description: Returns the current shopping cart object being manipulated.

methods.name: getFeatureAppl
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product feature application value based on product ID, option field, and feature ID.

methods.name: getRemoveFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Extracts the feature type ID from an option field string.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates an agreement with the cart, sets currency and order terms based on the agreement details.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the shopping cart, with error handling.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds an order term to the cart, supporting optional textual description.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the cart by index.
